title: Queen Archetypes
name: Queen
summary: Stewardship and public power; the task is to make authority serve life.
essence: Clear rule, proportionate judgment, and visible leadership that enlarges others.

items.name: Justice
items.gifts: Clear judgment that joins truthful consequence with the possibility of restoration.
items.growthPath: Tell the whole truth, including harm, context, agency, and the path back.
practices: Separate observed impact from motive and character judgment.
Choose the least consequence that can protect, teach, and repair.

shadows.name: Merciless Judge
description: Truth is narrowed to prosecution and stripped of mercy. She turns mistakes into identities, treats context as excuse, and uses accuracy to justify humiliation or permanent exile. Consequence loses its restorative purpose.
declarations: Compassion only weakens accountability.
Once revealed, character never changes.
The facts entitle me to condemn.
balancing: Name what evidence could demonstrate repair.
Apply the same standard to your own impact.
shadows.gift: Her clarity becomes principled judgment when it leaves room for proportion and transformation.

shadows.name: Permissive Witness
description: Truth collapses beneath mercy without consequence. She explains away patterns, protects people from the results of their choices, and mistakes understanding harm for making it safe. Compassion for the actor eclipses care for those affected.
declarations: They had reasons, so I should not judge.
A consequence would be unkind.
Keeping connection matters most.
balancing: Name the behavior without softening it.
Center the safety of those affected.
Set a consequence tied to a clear standard.
shadows.gift: Her empathy becomes restorative mercy when it accompanies reality instead of obscuring it.

mature.title: Mature Justice
paragraphs: Mature Justice sees clearly without reducing a person to what she sees. She names harm, protects those affected, and applies proportionate consequences while preserving a path for accountability and repair. Mercy does not cancel truth; it keeps truth oriented toward a more just future.

declarations: I name what happened without making anyone less human.
Consequences protect values and invite change.
Context informs judgment; it does not erase impact.
Mercy and truth answer to the same restoration.

balance.qualities: Fair, Clear, Steady, Principled, Courageous, Measured, Compassionate, Honest, Balanced, Resolute

virtues.title: Truth
paragraphs: Truth gives judgment an accurate account of behavior, pattern, context, and impact.

virtues.title: Mercy
paragraphs: Mercy preserves proportion, humanity, and the possibility of return without denying harm.

items.name: Queen
items.gifts: Sovereign stewardship: ordering shared life so people and purpose can flourish.
items.growthPath: Claim authority openly and make its use answerable to service.
practices: For each decision, name who is served and who bears the cost.
Delegate one whole responsibility with authority to match.

shadows.name: Tyrannical Queen
description: Authority detaches from service. She centralizes decisions, manages dissent as disloyalty, and makes the realm dependent on her approval. Order becomes an extension of ego rather than a condition in which others can govern their own work.
declarations: Only I can hold the whole picture.
Questioning me weakens the realm.
Control is the price of excellence.
balancing: Publish the principle behind a decision.
Transfer real authority, not only tasks.
shadows.gift: Her command becomes coherent leadership when power is used to cultivate other people's capacity.

shadows.name: Abdicating Queen
description: Authority collapses into service without rule. She accommodates every claim, delays decisions, and calls self-erasure humility, leaving the group to contend with a vacuum of direction. Refusing power does not remove power; it lets it become informal and unaccountable.
declarations: A good leader should not impose.
Consensus will eventually decide for us.
My preference should come last.
balancing: Make the decision that belongs to your role.
State a principled no without apology.
Accept visibility and answer for the result.
shadows.gift: Her humility becomes participatory leadership when she occupies the seat entrusted to her.

mature.title: Mature Queen
paragraphs: The Mature Queen occupies authority without making herself the center of the realm. She sets direction, establishes fair limits, distributes power, and accepts responsibility for decisions that only she can make. Her service is structural: people flourish because the order she tends is clear, humane, and larger than her personality.

declarations: I use power to make shared purpose possible.
My authority is visible and accountable.
I decide, explain, and remain open to correction.
A strong realm grows more capable leaders.

balance.qualities: Sovereign, Nurturing, Wise, Generous, Protective, Creative, Gracious, Confident, Harmonious, Inspiring

virtues.title: Authority
paragraphs: Authority supplies legitimate direction, decision, and protection for a shared order.

virtues.title: Service
paragraphs: Service aims authority toward the flourishing of the people and purpose entrusted to it.

items.name: Luminary
items.gifts: The sky, sun, and star current: visible radiance that reveals a wider horizon.
items.growthPath: Shine so others can see more clearly, including their own light.
practices: Share the platform with someone whose gift differs from yours.
Ask what your visibility makes possible beyond recognition.

shadows.name: Blinding Star
description: Radiance loses humility and becomes a demand for orbit. She converts attention into rank, performs magnitude, and occupies every opening for visibility. Other people's light is welcomed only when it reflects her own.
declarations: If I am not seen, the moment is being wasted.
My gift deserves the center.
Others benefit from my brightness.
balancing: Step back without announcing the sacrifice.
Credit the people and conditions behind the work.
Use visibility to direct attention beyond yourself.
shadows.gift: Her charisma becomes illumination when it reveals more than the self displaying it.

shadows.name: Hidden Light
description: Radiance contracts under humility distorted into disappearance. She understates contribution, refuses visibility, and lets less prepared voices define the horizon. Avoiding envy or judgment becomes a reason not to offer what could guide others.
declarations: Taking space would diminish someone else.
The work should speak without me.
Visibility is vanity.
balancing: Accept one visible role without self-deprecation.
Let service include being recognizable and findable.
shadows.gift: Her modesty becomes grounded presence when she can be seen without making visibility her worth.

mature.title: Mature Luminary
paragraphs: The Mature Luminary is willing to be seen and uninterested in being worshiped. Her presence enlarges perspective, gives courage, and directs attention toward what matters. She knows her light is relational—made possible by source, teachers, community, and those who choose to look.

declarations: I shine in service of clearer seeing.
Visibility is a responsibility, not a rank.
Another's brilliance does not reduce mine.
I can be fully seen and remain teachable.

balance.qualities: Radiant, Visionary, Expansive, Humble, Noble, Illuminating, Uplifting, Grounded, Warm, Inspirational

virtues.title: Radiance
paragraphs: Radiance makes a gift visible, warming attention and widening what others imagine possible.

virtues.title: Humility
paragraphs: Humility remembers interdependence, limitation, and the larger purpose visibility serves.
